operations.detail: Current contract, canonical branch HEAD, unclaimed owner and absence of all five expected runtime outputs were read back.
Published daemon heartbeat and single-runner lock were reread and remain stale relative to the twenty-minute recovery threshold.
Residual taskkill tree race audited: descendants attached after the generation check could be terminated without individual identity proof.
Helper 001 taskkill /T collateral-process risk identified despite PID plus CreationDate and canonical command precheck.
Helper 001 now snapshots the stale canonical set and stops each verified process generation individually, non-daemons before the daemon.
Any canonical process appearing outside the stale snapshot is preserved and causes fail-closed restart blocking instead of being terminated.
Preflight 002 and ff-only bootstrap 003 repinned to helper ea0916430e8ac12eb3f1cbb9db3983e3a000de7d with taskkill-tree-used false receipt evidence.
Watchdog 004 no longer uses taskkill /T; wrapper, descendants and attempt-spawned canonical processes are stopped as individual verified generations.
Watchdog stop now binds a System.Diagnostics.Process object and compares its StartTime with the current CIM CreationDate before termination.
Recovery chain ea0916 to 01d2dc to b37ef3 to f68e69 remotely read back; same attempt and single-runner boundaries remain preserved.
